summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for US Gold Gymnastics site. 21/21 pytest backend tests pass and 12/12 UI flows pass end-to-end (auth, quote/lead, contact, birthday booking with waiver, calendar with filters, admin dashboard tabs showing real submitted data).

minor.issue: Returns 401 (expected) on unauthenticated page loads; surfaces as red console errors on public pages. Consider swallowing in AuthContext or checking cookie presence before calling.

issues: public/index.html <title> is still 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of the gym brand

action_items: Update public/index.html <title> to gym-branded name (e.g., 'US Gold Gymnastics & Cheer Academy').
(Optional) Silence expected 401 from /api/auth/me by not logging as error in axios interceptor, or by skipping the call when no auth cookie exists.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager for future compatibility.
server.py: CORS allow_origins only includes FRONTEND_URL + localhost. Good, but backend/.env still keeps unused CORS_ORIGINS='*' variable — remove to avoid confusion.
Auth cookies use SameSite=None; Secure=True which is required for cross-origin cookies over HTTPS — correct for the preview URL. Ensure production is served over HTTPS or logins will silently fail.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout implemented on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-attempt lockout). If required by spec, add a simple counter or use slowapi.
Bookings do not validate 'date' format (accepts any string). Consider using date type or validator.
Admin dashboard lists all bookings but does not paginate — fine at MVP scale, will need pagination beyond a few hundred records.
test_credentials: Admin admin@usgoldgym.com / GymAdmin2026! (seeded on startup). Parents registered dynamically during tests with TEST_ / uitest_ email prefixes.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates timestamped parent accounts, leads, contacts and bookings. Events auto-seeded by backend for July/Aug 2026.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seeds admin + 8 events on startup. bcrypt hash format is $2b$ (correct). httpOnly cookies work end-to-end. All critical data-testids exist. UI booking flow requires parent to be logged in — BookingDialog shows Log In/Register buttons when unauthenticated (works). Calendar defaults to current month (Jan 2026 empty); use cal-next to reach July/Aug 2026 where seeded events live.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. All happy-path and permission (403/401/400 waiver) cases pass.
